Lab 6

Multi-Agent Router

@llm-series/agent-router

AgentRouter uses an LLM to classify your query and dispatch it to the most appropriate specialized agent. Each agent has a name, description, and its own system prompt.

💡 The routing LLM sees all agent names + descriptions and returns {"agent": "name"}. AgentRouter.route() then calls that agent's run() with the original messages.
